outcome.Summary: Fixed six bugs in the INI parser in ini/ini.go to match its documented format: (1) lines are now trimmed before processing, so indented sections like "  [Server]" parse; (2) '#' full-line comments are recognized; (3) section names are lower-cased; (4) the first '=' separates key and value (was LastIndex), so values may contain '='; (5) quoted values keep inner whitespace exactly and skip inline-comment stripping, while unquoted values strip inline comments only at " ;"/" #" (previously any ';' cut the value); (6) repeated keys now overwrite instead of keeping the first. Verified with `go test ./... -count=1`, which passes.
